{"id": "mm6407a8",
 "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "note", "q": "These results represent independent FDA analysis of results from study ACTG A5295/TBTC 34."}, {"loc": "summary", "q": "a single negative Xpert MTB/RIF Assay result predicted the absence of AFB smear–positive pulmonary tuberculosis with a negative predictive value of 99.7%"}]},
 "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "14.2% [88 of 618] in the United States and 37.1% [127 of 342] outside the United States"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "one or two Xpert MTB/RIF Assay tests detected 55% and 69%, respectively, of sputum specimens that were AFB smear–negative but culture-positive"}]}],
 "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In the setting of an overall prevalence of culture-confirmed pulmonary tuberculosis of 22.4%"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "14.2% [88 of 618] in the United States and 37.1% [127 of 342] outside the United States"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "(99.6%% in the United States and 100% outside the United States)"}]}],
 "study_design": [{"v": "diagnostic accuracy", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "negative Xpert MTB/RIF Assay results from either one or two sputum specimens are highly predictive"}]}, {"v": "guidance or recommendations", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the decision whether to test one or two sputum specimens in determining the need for continued AII"}]}],
 "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "note", "q": "These results represent independent FDA analysis of results from study ACTG A5295/TBTC 34."}, {"loc": "summary", "q": "a single Xpert MTB/RIF Assay result detected approximately 97% of patients who were acid-fast bacilli (AFB) smear–positive"}],
 "confidence": "medium",
